ctx.x: My daughter started, she took piano and sang, but right quick she says I don't want to be a musician--she don't have anything against it, but I think as far as love, she loves me and Ernie does too, and she has nothing against any music, in fact, she used to travel with me. She would go along with me, but it's right funny, she was just tickled to death until one time we went to some club and they were so particular about it, they had to put her separate, she couldn't be where the ball was, and that hurt her. She…

I'll never forget, she was making the rounds once through Missouri, and that's when Jackie Robinson (inaudible), and I want to go to a baseball game and I had some night off, I think I played Springfield and was headed into St. Louis but I wanted to go the
night before to see the ballgame, and Carmen got tired and she was sleeping and she finally woke up and she said, daddy, this sure is a long road.
